profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at XPO
profile.summary: Lead Software Engineer with over 8 years of experience in Web Development, initially starting as a back-end/full-stack .NET developer, now specialized in front-end applications with Angular 2-8.  Ample experience designing responsive, user-friendly interfaces and robust, enterprise-grade, optimized applications designed with years of learning best practices and implementing battle-tested processes.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead Software Engineer for the LTL Web Team, which focuses on customer-facing applications that help them with their day-to-day shipping operations, consuming the company's existing back-end endpoints from previous or related applications, while delivering a brand-new, fresh customer experience and enhanced, smart interfaces.

Main responsibilities include creating customer facing services and interfaces, making use of the company's employee/core infrastructure and services, adding a security and validation layer to make them usable to external API consumers, as well as frontend applications, including our own external web app. Lead a team of developers, QA Engineers, business analysts, and coordinate delivers, timelines and general technical project leadership with team management and product owners.

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description: Contractor for TekSystems working with XPO Logistics as a Frontend Developer, then Tech Lead.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description: Frontend Developer for Fiserv, mainly working on a big angular enterprise app on a frontend team.

positions.title: Front-End Developer
positions.description: Contractor for EY Global Innovation Services as Front-End Developer, part of a development team on the role of Sr. Front End Developer in charge of the applications' User Interface, User Experience and Front End Business Logic design and implementation. Main skills include HTML5/CSS3/Bootstrap for page design and Javascript/Typescript/ES6 using Angular 4 for the business logic and rules implementation.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Sr. Software Developer assigned to various roles depending on the assigned project. Also assisting as Technical Trainer for cutting-edge technologies for the Re-Skilling program. Main projects include Production Support Specialist at E&Y, and Sr. Front End Developer at E&Y as well.
As trainer, taught skills and projects include working with: Angular 2-5, React.js v16, Node.js / Express.js, MongoDB, ASP.NET MVC 5, Entity Framework 6 and .NET WebAPI.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description: Intermediate and then Senior Lead Developer for the company's main ERP System. Main achievements include: Migrating an existing solution to a more newer SOA, Leading a team of developers and testers in front of a major client, designing and implementing design patterns, implementing and following SCRUM methodologies, working on-site with the client as Lead Developer and sometimes as stand-in Technical Lead when needed. Main technologies used were VB.NET, MS SQL and Windows Forms.

positions.title: Junior Software Developer
positions.description: Junior developer working on ongoing ERP software projects for several local clients. Main skills include C# Development of Web Parts for a Sharepoint site.
